metadata.description: Engineering skills for hardware work, plus a git guardrail hook and a curated set of general skills. Each skill is a separate plugin.

plugins.name: hw-read
plugins.description: Read a KiCad or Altium hardware project from its project files into structured JSON: parts, nets, rules, stackup and layout geometry.

plugins.name: sch-review
plugins.description: Schematic review for KiCad and Altium projects: mechanical netlist checks plus a datasheet pass per IC. Needs hw-read.

plugins.name: emc-precheck
plugins.description: Port protection pre-check for KiCad and Altium boards: clamps, their ratings and placement, an HTML board view, and surge, burst and ESD pulse simulation of a port. Needs hw-read.

plugins.name: pcb-review
plugins.description: Layout review for KiCad and Altium boards: decoupling distance, differential pairs, reference planes, dangling tracks, edge and isolation distances, with an HTML board view. Needs hw-read.

plugins.name: hw-notes
plugins.description: Bilingual (EN/TR) commit messages and Redmine descriptions for Altium hardware repos, with work hour estimate.

plugins.name: git-guardrails
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that lets the agent run read-only git commands only. Commit, push, checkout, reset and every other write is blocked in the Bash and PowerShell tools.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Interview that stress-tests a plan or design in numbered rounds, each question with a recommended answer, until nothing is left assumed.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document so a fresh session can continue the work.

plugins.name: writing-for-agents
plugins.description: Reference for writing documents agents read: skills, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: wait-what
plugins.description: The last answer did not land: make the agent re-explain it in plain words.

plugins.name: to-questionnaire
plugins.description: Turn a decision you cannot answer alone into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.

plugins.name: diagnosing-bugs
plugins.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions: build a tight reproduction, form hypotheses, measure, then fix.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research a question against primary sources in a background agent and save the findings as a Markdown file.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review the changes since a commit, branch or tag against the repo's coding standards and against the originating spec, in two parallel subagents.

plugins.name: codebase-design
plugins.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules: small interfaces, hidden implementation, and where the seams go.
